name: Acciona, S.A.
summary: Acciona, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides energy and infrastructure solutions in Spain and internationally. It develops, constructs, operates, and maintains wind, solar photovoltaic, hydropower, thermal solar, and biomass plants, as well as offers energy storage, renewable energy supply, energy efficiency, self-consumption, green hydrogen, and electric mobility solutions; and designs, develops, manufactures, and distributes wind turbines.
